usage: tunnel serve [-h] [--base BASE] [--json] [--admin-port PORT]
                    [--proxy-port PORT] [--proxy-host HOST] [--config-dir DIR]
                    [--background]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --base BASE           where the admin API answers (default
                        http://127.0.0.1:8000)
  --json                print raw JSON, errors included, for piping into jq
  --admin-port, --port PORT
                        panel and admin API, on 127.0.0.1 (default 8000)
  --proxy-port PORT     the port devices proxy through (default 8890)
  --proxy-host HOST     address the proxy port binds (default 0.0.0.0, every
                        interface)
  --config-dir DIR      put config, state and data in this one directory
                        (default: the nearest .tunnel/, else the user
                        directories)
  --background          start it in a process of its own and return once it
                        answers; `tunnel status` and `tunnel stop` follow it
